thread:
alex: quick smoke ask before v2 canary — does /v2/generate ever return the `metadata` key as `null`, or does it omit it when empty? we hit a frontend parsing glitch earlier.
maria: i ran a couple requests against staging canary. when callers don't include metadata the response simply omits `metadata`. when callers explicitly pass an empty object we get `\"metadata\": {}`. i didn't see any `null` values.
jordan: confirmed on my side. our python serializer strips nulls by default so absent => omitted.
sam.k: fyi the TS SDK types historically allowed `metadata: Record<string,string> | null` (codegen from older schema). some older clients still check for `=== null`.
alex: ok. two concerns: 1) old clients that expect `null` might break; 2) docs need clarity. options: return `null` for compatibility during canary, or keep omitting and push SDK/docs changes.
maria: i prefer omitting optional keys when empty (keeps payload smaller). suggestion: add a compatibility header to opt into `null` behavior and update SDK to coerce missing->null for one release window.
jordan: that sounds reasonable. an alternative is to add a linter in the API contract tests that ensures we never emit naked `null` for objects unless explicitly defined as nullable in the schema.
sam.k: implementing a per-request `serialize_nulls` flag in runtime is cheap. i can add support for header `X-Compat-Null: true` that forces nulls for absent optional fields. toggle default = false.
alex: also noticed some clients got confused by content-type on streaming vs non-streaming endpoints. we should assert exact header values in tests.
maria: yes — streaming endpoints must use `application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8` and non-streaming must be `application/json; charset=utf-8`. tiny mismatch breaks some parsers (esp mobile).
jordan: i'll add a tiny smoketest script for both cases. example quick check:

```
# non-streaming check
curl -s -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  'https://staging.redwood.ai/v2/generate' | jq -c '.metadata // \"<omitted>\"'

# streaming check
curl -s -H 'Accept: application/x-ndjson' \
  'https://staging.redwood.ai/v2/generate?stream=true' | head -n1
```

sam.k: i'll wire runtime flag + unit test + docs note. plan: enable `X-Compat-Null: true` for the first canary wave for 24h if we see client errors, then flip off and require SDK update.
alex: great. can someone file a tiny docs PR clarifying omit vs null and add SDK migration note? also add an API-contract linter rule for content-type and no-naked-null objects.
maria: filing PR for docs now, will reference the smoke script.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2024-09-12T15:00Z — health checks watching :eyes:
alex: awesome, thanks all. i'll update the release note with the compat header plan and link the docs PR when it's up.
